items.title: Acute Gastrointestinal Bleeding
highYieldSummary: Assess airway risk, hemodynamic status, bleeding severity, anticoagulants, liver disease, and the likely upper or lower source.
Resuscitate while arranging blood testing, risk assessment, reversal decisions, and early specialist consultation when instability or ongoing bleeding is present.
Use history, examination, laboratory data, and targeted imaging or endoscopy to guide source control.
Disposition depends on physiology, recurrence risk, comorbidity, reliable follow-up, and local pathway.
examPearls: Shock can precede obvious external blood loss.
examTraps: Do not use a risk score as a substitute for clinical reassessment.
items.arabicExplanation: قيّم مجرى الهواء والدورة الدموية وشدة النزف والأدوية. ابدأ الإنعاش بالتوازي مع تحديد المصدر والتواصل المبكر مع الاختصاصي عند عدم الاستقرار.

items.title: Asthma and COPD Exacerbation
highYieldSummary: Grade severity by work of breathing, speech, mental status, oxygenation, ventilation, prior admissions, and response to initial therapy.
Treat bronchospasm and hypoxemia promptly while searching for infection, pneumothorax, pulmonary edema, and other mimics.
Escalate support when fatigue, altered consciousness, rising carbon dioxide, or refractory hypoxemia develops.
Before discharge, verify response, inhaler technique, trigger plan, follow-up, and return precautions.
examPearls: A quiet chest in a tiring patient can indicate critical airflow limitation.
examTraps: Do not judge severity from wheeze loudness alone.
items.arabicExplanation: حدد شدة النوبة من جهد التنفس والوعي والأكسجة والاستجابة، وليس من صوت الصفير وحده. عالج التشنج وابحث عن الأسباب الخطرة مع تصعيد الدعم عند التعب.

items.title: Acute Kidney Injury and Electrolyte Emergencies
highYieldSummary: Confirm the abnormal result and assess ECG, perfusion, urine output, medication exposure, obstruction, and rapidly dangerous electrolyte patterns.
Treat immediately life-threatening electrical or hemodynamic effects while investigating the underlying cause.
Review renal function and medication dosing during resuscitation and involve nephrology or critical care when refractory or severe.
Repeat tests after treatment and provide a clear monitoring and follow-up plan.
examPearls: The ECG may show danger before the laboratory value is available.
examTraps: Do not treat an isolated number without checking symptoms, ECG, trend, and sampling error.
items.arabicExplanation: ابدأ بتقييم التخطيط والتروية والبول والأدوية. عالج التأثيرات القلبية الخطرة فورًا، ثم ابحث عن السبب وأعد الفحوص بعد العلاج.

items.title: Emergency Care in Pregnancy
highYieldSummary: Stabilize the pregnant patient first while accounting for gestational age, physiologic changes, trauma, bleeding, pain, and fetal considerations.
Use pregnancy-appropriate imaging and medications when needed; do not withhold time-critical maternal diagnosis or treatment because of pregnancy.
Involve obstetrics early for bleeding, hypertensive disease, abdominal pain, trauma, or maternal instability.
Document maternal and fetal assessment, consultation, treatment response, and follow-up.
examPearls: Maternal stabilization is the first fetal intervention.
examTraps: Do not assume a negative early test excludes ectopic pregnancy.
items.arabicExplanation: ثبّت الأم أولًا، فاستقرارها هو أفضل تدخل للجنين. حدّد عمر الحمل واستشر النسائية مبكرًا عند النزف أو الألم أو عدم الاستقرار.

items.title: Behavioral Emergencies and Agitation
highYieldSummary: Protect staff and patient, use verbal de-escalation when feasible, and rapidly assess for delirium, hypoxia, hypoglycemia, intoxication, withdrawal, trauma, and medical illness.
Use the least restrictive effective intervention with continuous observation and appropriate monitoring.
Treat the cause, reassess capacity and risk, and involve mental-health or medical specialists according to the presentation.
Document behavior, alternatives attempted, proportionality, monitoring, response, and disposition reasoning.
examPearls: New agitation in an older adult is delirium until proven otherwise.
examTraps: Do not label agitation as psychiatric before checking reversible medical causes.
items.arabicExplanation: احمِ المريض والفريق وابدأ بالتهدئة اللفظية إن أمكن. ابحث عن الهذيان ونقص الأكسجة والسكر والسموم والمرض العضوي قبل افتراض سبب نفسي.
